summary: Remove the backup repository generation field and the member-side same-ID credential rotation it modelled. Core already refused same-ID source or credential changes, so the generation never advanced; rotation registers a new repository ID and switches Core-owned policies to it. API impact: changed contract (field and peer response members removed, no new route).

guide.reason: The Host access troubleshooting entry for a member that had not adopted a newer repository generation described a state that can no longer occur and is removed. The existing rotation steps (register and test a new repository, switch policies) are unchanged.

api.reason: BackupRepository loses generation in the Controller, local and peer contracts. Peer capability responses (smb3, s3, sftp) return only credential_ref plus identity or fingerprint; the peer credential projection loses retired; the access probe no longer requires a nonzero generation. A member refuses a projection or capability request whose credential reference differs from its record for the same repository ID. Controller and Core must match (no mixed-version compatibility, owner decision 2026-09-29).

roadmap.reason: Records an owner simplification decision in the destinations plan; no scope change.

state.record: pool-backup-repositories.json on the pool master, replicated in signed pool backup authority, now without a generation field; Core-private backup credential receipts are unchanged. A fresh Controller recovers repositories through authenticated master inventory as before.
state.reason: Removes a field; adds no state. The master still retires receipts of abandoned same-ID registration attempts and now removes their SMB3 mount credential file in the same step.

verification.method: go build, full go test, generate_api.py --check, check_docs.py --worktree and the API contract unittest. TestSupersededBackupCredentialRetirement failed against a go test -overlay mutant without the moved SMB3 file cleanup and passed with it. Same-ID credential change refusal is covered by TestPeerBackupCredentialScopeAndPromotion; exact identity checks by the renamed *PreflightRequiresPrivateReceiptExactIdentity tests.
verification.limits: No lab, native-server or forge CI run. Web unit test updated but not run in this batch.
